text: Simple and straightforward, just what I was looking for! Gives you the opportunity to test the app with three habits before you go premium. Has some tips and tricks about forming new habits for those that are interested.
author: Sandra

text: Really helpful for making me do things which I really should be doing. Love the browser extension that constantly reminds you to do your stuff and it's so rewarding to see that long gradient.

developer_reply: Hi Caroline, the app is free to use with some limitations. If there weren't some paid limitations I wouldn't be able to pay for my bills and work on it and thus the app wouldn't exist. Either that or what other apps do, which would be make money off your private data. This sort of ratings don't help indie developers but big corps. Thanks though.
